description: Decode a CVSS v3.0/v3.1 vector into its base metrics and recompute its base, temporal and environmental scores. Use it on a vector you hold; cve_lookup already gives the scores of a CVE. v2 and v4 are refused.

vector.description: CVSS:3.0/ or CVSS:3.1/ vector with all eight base metrics; temporal and environmental metrics are optional, e.g. CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H

name: cvss_calculator
title: CVSS Calculator
